CustomField.description: True when the first touch came after First Response Due, or has not come and the due time has passed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: True when the first touch came after First Response Due, or has not come and the due time has passed.
CustomField.label: SLA Breached
CustomField.formula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(First_Response_Due__c)), IF(ISBLANK(First_Touch_At__c), NOW() > First_Response_Due__c, First_Touch_At__c > First_Response_Due__c) )
